why: Look at the arms: they show all the positions in turn: left down/right up, left up/right down, both down, so next both arms are up (only options 1 and 2). The legs come back to the pose of the first figure (left foot pointing down, right foot raised). Option 2 has both arms up and these legs. Option 1 has both arms up but the legs of figures 2 and 3.
trick: In stick-man series check the arms and the legs separately; each part follows its own rule.
